analysis_method: full-duration mixed-audio note-hypothesis pass; 8 kHz mono, 1024 FFT, 256 hop, spectral-flux onsets, up to four tonal pitch hypotheses per onset
rights_disposition: DERIVED_ONLY until explicit training permission is recorded
limitations: The sources are mixed recordings, not isolated piano stems.
Pitch events are automatic hypotheses and are not ground-truth transcription.
Instrument attribution is intentionally withheld at this stage.
Exact-note hypotheses remain private/local and are not committed to the public repository.
No runtime Bill Evans prior may be promoted from these aggregate measurements without score/form alignment and listening verification.
